summary: Tested the new NutriVane 'Your Mood' AI feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL (guest recommend returns valid structured response with source='ai' from Gemini, auth call persists current_country/origin_country to the profile and is reflected in /api/me, unknown mood -> 404, missing mood_key -> 422, story >1200 chars -> 422, PUT /api/me/countries guarded + working, mood_logs row inserted per call verified via psql, regression on /health /moods /moods/berenergi /recipes /home). Frontend (/mood at 390px): mood selector, story textarea, country inputs, swap button, submit, loading skeleton, AI result with headline/summary/items/tip/source, item link navigation to /recipes/<slug>, mood change clears previous result, 'Racik ulang' retry re-requests AI, curated mood-recipe cards + see-all link present, logged-in flow pre-fills country inputs from /api/me after reload. No horizontal overflow at 390px. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/mood/recommend uses two SQL statements to persist countries when it could be a single upsert; mood_logs.story is stripped but inserted even when empty (acceptable, just noting).
Frontend go_back() from /recipes/<slug> back to /mood loses the AI result (in-memory state). Non-blocking but could be surfaced to UX if desired (e.g., keep last result in session storage).
test_credentials: Dev JWT at /app/memory/dev_token.txt (user Asha, email asha@example.com). Mint with: cd /app/backend && /root/.venv/bin/python scripts/dev_token.py. Local Postgres: PGPASSWORD=nutrivane psql -h localhost -U postgres -d nutrivane.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Tests inserted rows into mood_logs and updated profiles.current_country/origin_country for the Asha dev user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mood AI feature fully green. Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_mood_recommend.py (uses pytest.ini config but requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env; run with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mood_recommend.py -o addopts=''). AI calls take ~15-20s; use timeouts >=45s. Dev token: /app/memory/dev_token.txt.
